checks.expected: 山路拋錨使行程耽擱四小時。凌晨三點，我抵達山屋。
A breakdown delayed me by four hours. I reached the cabin at three in the morning.
委託我的人，是記者林依瑤。她害怕那封邀請背後的意思。
The reporter Lin Yiyao had hired me. The invitation frightened her.
邀請函來自主辦人王杰倫。五年前，他從另一場大火中活了下來。
The invitation was signed by Wang Jielun, survivor of another fire five years ago.
林依瑤，記者。受邀採訪五週年聚會，私下委託偵探保護。
Lin Yiyao, Reporter. Invited to cover the anniversary; privately hired the detective.
王杰倫，聚會主辦人。五年前火災倖存者，邀請與舊事相關的人重返山屋。
Wang Jielun, Host. Survivor of the old fire; invited people connected to the past.
劉涵，成年恩人好友。長期送物資照顧王杰倫，希望用烤肉派對讓他重新生活。
Liu Han, Adult friend and benefactor. Supported Wang for years and hoped the barbecue would cheer him.
張萍，心理醫生。受邀見證聲稱的康復，攜帶個案紀錄與醫療公事包。
Zhang Ping, Psychological clinician. Invited to witness a claimed recovery; carried case records.
劉子傑，攝影師。受酬拍攝紀念照，以手機記錄工作花絮，兩張合照都在鏡頭後。
Liu Zijie, Photographer. Paid to photograph the gathering; recorded work fragments and stayed behind the camera.
警方通報四具成年人焦屍，身分待驗；起火原因仍在調查。
Four adult bodies, identification pending. The cause remained under investigation.
我留在封鎖線外，取得許可後，只沿已確認的安全區調查。
I waited outside the cordon, then entered only the cleared investigation route.
灰綠外套與散落原稿留下記者的痕跡。那封信，是她恐懼的來源。
The coat and scattered drafts marked the reporter’s presence. The letter explained her fear.
被刪掉的房內對話，讓我找到了衣架後的文書。真正被隱藏的是她保留的調查資料。
Deleted room instructions led to papers behind the coat rack. She had concealed investigative leads.
她隱匿的，是原本能繼續追查的線索。為了名聲，她把事件寫成懸案。
She had suppressed leads to preserve the attention of an unsolved case.
報紙與私人筆記並不一致。但她的秘密，還不能證明她犯下今晚的罪。
The clipping and private notes differed. Her secret did not prove responsibility for tonight.
三只杯子與空瓶留下殘留。此刻，我只能記錄，不能用肉眼完成鑑定。
Three glasses and a bottle held residues. I could record them, not identify them by sight.
手機保留了拍攝預覽與工作花絮，警方交付的是當晚匯出的副本。
The phone retained previews and work fragments. Police supplied a copy exported that night.
十八點三十分，四人在鏡頭前。劉子傑掌鏡，偵探尚未到場。
At 18:30 four people stood in frame. Liu Zijie held the camera; I had not arrived.
二十點，鏡頭前只剩三人。劉涵消失了。
At 20:00 only three remained in frame. Liu Han was absent.
缺席不是死亡證明。我需要把時刻、工作片段與其他痕跡放在一起。
Absence was not proof of death. I needed to compare the times, recordings and traces.
缺席不是死亡證明。我需要把時刻、工作片段與其他痕跡放在一起。
Absence was not proof of death. I needed to compare the times, recordings and traces.
劉涵是成年恩人好友。這次聚會，他只希望讓王杰倫重新開心。
Liu Han, an adult friend and benefactor, had hoped to cheer Wang up.
十九點十分，他還在為自己的好意道歉。
At 19:10 he was still apologizing for a well-meant gesture.
儲藏室的錶停在十九點十五分，血痕旁有擦拭與撞擊痕跡。
The storage-room watch stopped at 19:15, beside wiped blood and impact traces.
表層報告讓我一度把顫抖看成對火的恐懼。這只是暫時推測。
The visible report made me read the trembling as fear of fire. It was only a hypothesis.
預定食材五公斤，歷史淨載重卻是六十五公斤；即時值與歷史分開保存。
Five kilograms of planned food, but sixty-five in the historical record. Current and historical values were separate.
滑輪配重抬起檢修蓋後，我取得地下室內門鑰匙；底座顯示的六十五公斤仍是歷史紀錄。
After the pulley counterweight raised the service cover, I retrieved the inner-door key. The base’s 65 kg display remained the historical record.
開格後才可觸及的項鍊，輪廓與第一張照片一致。
The pendant, reachable only after opening the hatch, matched the first photograph.
日記、停錶、重量與項鍊指向同一處。但真正的原因，仍在地下。
The diary, watch, load and pendant converged. The reason remained below.
問句不是結論。我從案史頁重建孔路，取出了張萍保留的完整紀錄。
Questions were not conclusions. The case-history pages led to Zhang Ping’s complete record.
五年前，先有火災與受困，才有在極端飢餓下食用親屬遺體的往事。
Five years earlier the fire and entrapment came first, followed by consumption of relatives’ remains in extreme hunger.
五年後的營火，喚醒的可能不是恐懼，而是王杰倫壓抑的食慾。
The new barbecue may have awakened Wang’s suppressed appetite rather than fear.
【案件重建】十九點十五分附近，劉涵在儲藏室遭襲，手錶撞裂。
[Reconstruction] Around 19:15 Liu Han was assaulted in storage and the watch shattered.
【案件重建】異常載重與項鍊，把劉涵、儲藏室與烤架連在一起。
[Reconstruction] The load and pendant linked Liu Han, storage and the grill.
工作片段顯示取瓶與三人後來失去活動；殘留成分仍待正式檢驗。
Fragments showed a bottle being taken and three guests later unresponsive. Residues still awaited testing.
張萍的紀錄不是定罪書。我要用照片、日記與現場關係交叉重建。
Zhang’s notes were not a verdict. Photographs, diary and scene relationships had to corroborate one another.
鐵櫃在火災中倒下。警方協助移開後，原先的通路才重新露出。
The cabinet fell in the fire. With police assistance it was moved, exposing the route.
門框先被使用，灰後來才覆上。痕跡只支持相對先後，不單獨認人。
The frame had been used before ash settled. Traces established order, not a unique person.
主門反鎖，卻不代表所有出口封死。當晚不能確認王杰倫死亡，他可能已逃離。
A bolted main door did not seal every exit. Wang’s death was unconfirmed. He might have escaped.
【真相重建】王杰倫利用聚會控制舊事相關者，氣味觸發後，對劉涵與其餘三人下手。
[Truth reconstructed] Wang used the gathering for control. The smell triggered the attacks on Liu Han and the others.
他反鎖主門並引發火災掩飾，火開始蔓延時，從維修出口離開。
He bolted the main door and set the new fire to conceal the crime, escaping as it spread.
之後鐵櫃倒下。貼屋露台與烤架塌向低側客廳，先遇害的劉涵也包括在四具遺體中。
The cabinet fell later. The terrace and grill collapsed toward the lower living room; Liu Han was included among the four bodies.
我朝森林出口奔去。身後的視角，卻留在原地。
I ran toward the forest exit. The viewpoint behind me remained still.
當晚返回取控制器的身影，躲入了枯樹。有人一直注視這裡。
Returning for the controller that night, a figure hid in the hollow tree. Someone was watching.
［吞嚥聲］控制器當前值歸零，固定底座的歷史紀錄並未刪除。
[Swallowing] The controller’s current reading reset. History remained in the fixed base.
冷光照亮那張熟悉的臉。王杰倫還活著。
Cold light revealed the familiar face. Wang Jielun was alive.
真相有時比廢墟還要焦黑。真正的怪物，已隱入森林。
Truth can be darker than the ruins. The monster had vanished into the forest.
數日後，正式身分核對才完成。當晚的四具遺體，終於有了名字。
Days later formal identification was completed. The four bodies finally had names.
林依瑤。她為名聲壓下調查線索，失實報導令真相被延後；這不等於她犯下當晚罪行。
Lin Yiyao. She suppressed leads for attention. That does not establish responsibility for the new crime.
劉涵。他先於最後合照遭襲，與烤架異常及項鍊相關，也包括在四名死者之內。
Liu Han. Assaulted before the last photograph; connected to the grill and pendant, and included among the four dead.
張萍。保存五年前的隱藏診療紀錄；病歷不能直接認罪或洗清嫌疑，正式結果仍須交叉核對。
Zhang Ping. Held concealed clinical notes. A record alone establishes neither guilt nor innocence.
劉子傑。零散工作片段提供拍攝順序與取物線索，並未完整錄下犯罪。
Liu Zijie. His fragments corroborate sequence and handling of objects, not the entire crime.
調查結束。你可以回訪章節、重看動畫、閱讀完整解答，或重新整理最終推理。
The investigation is complete. Revisit chapters, replay films, read solutions or retry the final reasoning.
